inv.desc_es:
LOCAL COMERCIAL EN PLENA CALLE CONDE ALTEA DE VALENCIA. -Ref-AG-49.

Consta de 162 m2 divididos en un amplio local, un baño completo, un aseo y un patio.

Dispone de varios escaparates y persianas eléctricas.

Edificio del año 1945.

Ubicado en una de las calles más demandadas de Pla del Remei, entre Císcar y Cirilo Amorós, a 100 metros de Calle Colón y Gran Vía Marqués del Turia. 

Paso de gente constante.

Zona con revalorización constante del 7% anual en los últimos 5 años. Últimos locales disponibles en esta calle.

Precio: 599.000 €.

inv.desc_en:
COMMERCIAL PREMISES ON CONDE ALTEA STREET IN VALENCIA. -Ref-AG-49.

It consists of 162 m2 divided into a spacious main area, a full bathroom, a restroom, and a patio.

It features several display windows and electric shutters.

Building from 1945.

Located on one of the most sought-after streets in Pla del Remei, between Císcar and Cirilo Amorós, 100 meters from Colón Street and Gran Vía Marqués del Turia.

Constant foot traffic.

Area with a constant revaluation of 7% per year over the last 5 years. One of the last available premises on this street.

Price: €599,000.

GRUPO SIMÓ Real Estate Consultants.

The information in this advertisement in its entirety (photos, text, or any other content) is shown for informational purposes, is not contractual, and is not binding, as the information is provided by third parties and may contain errors. The price does not include the following: real estate agency fees, ITP (Property Transfer Tax), and other purchase expenses (Notary, Registry, and administrative fees). The objects and furnishings in this advertisement are not included in the price; they are for informational purposes only and are not contractual.
